How PnL and ROE work on Binance

Binance is the largest crypto exchange by volume, offering the widest range of futures pairs and up to 125x leverage on majors. Your raw profit on a Binance trade is the price move times your position size: (Exit − Entry) × Size for a long, and the reverse for a short. Price ROI is the percentage the asset moved; ROE is your return on the margin you actually posted, which Binance's leverage multiplies.

Worked example

A 0.5-coin long opened at $60,000 and closed at $66,000 at 10× leverage:

Profit+$3,000.00
Price ROI+10.00%
ROE (10×)+100.00%

Leverage cuts both ways — the same move down would be a 100% loss of margin. Plan your exit and check your Binance liquidation price first.

FAQ

How is ROE different from ROI on Binance?

Price ROI is the raw % move. ROE multiplies it by your leverage — it is your return on posted margin. Fees and funding are not included.

Does Binance show PnL automatically?

Binance shows live PnL on open positions, but this tool lets you plan and compare scenarios before you trade.
